title: Token-Jaccard 0.86 separates a near paraphrase from a miss

steps.command: gf_macro task-run "format lint and test billing package before release quietly"

arguments.instruction: format lint and test billing package before release quietly

steps.expect: Near match. GraphFlow's token Jaccard is 0.875, above 0.86, and the runner executes.

steps.command: gf_macro task-run "format lint and test billing before release"

arguments.instruction: format lint and test billing before release

steps.expect: Drops one content token. Jaccard 0.857 is below 0.86, so the tool returns MISS and does not run the steps.

steps.command: graphflow reflect "ship the warehouse reservation hold" --json
steps.expect: Unrelated instruction is MISS. hit is false and the process exit code is 1.
